$comment: Foundry-owned persistent identity kernel carried inside internal_state.foundry_identity. Not ASA authority. The ASA UAO validation projection is a closed schema, so Foundry-owned identity material is carried here rather than as top-level UAO members. uid and lifecycle_status are deliberately absent: both are ASA-governed top-level members and are not restated.
title: UAO Foundry Persistent Identity Kernel

alias_provenance.$comment: Every name the identity was seen under, canonical label included, with the candidate that used it and the sources behind that candidate. A name without provenance cannot later be weighed against a competing name. Outside identity_digest: this records how the identity was evidenced, not what it is.

semantic_type.$comment: Null is meaningful and required to be explicit: an ext: key names which object is meant without saying what kind of object it is. A guessed type would be indistinguishable from a declared one.

external_identifiers.$comment: Durable third-party identifiers. Evidence about identity, never identity itself. Scheme grammar (^[a-z][a-z0-9._-]*$) is enforced by identity/ExternalIdentifiers rather than here, because the Foundry validator deliberately supports a small fixed keyword set and does not implement propertyNames. The Java discipline is the stricter of the two and the verifier re-derives it.

identity_digest.$comment: Derived, never authored. Covers identity-bearing material only and is stable across state change.

state_version.$comment: Derived, never authored. Covers state-bearing material only. Not a significance, confidence, ranking or priority value.
